title: Keep queue pressure and failure blast radius bounded
description: Configure a modeled GPU serving path. Every choice changes the queue, memory fit, safety boundary, retry load, or rollout exposure.
notice: Illustrative capacity model. Measure real throughput, memory, quality, and safety on the exact model bundle and hardware before setting production limits.

workloads.label: Interactive editor
workloads.detail: Small jobs with a tight feedback deadline.

workloads.label: Campaign burst
workloads.detail: A temporary burst of compatible marketing generations.

workloads.label: Premium export
workloads.detail: Low-volume, high-resolution jobs with strict publication quality.

runtimes.label: Base model · FP16
runtimes.detail: Measured quality baseline with moderate memory demand.

runtimes.label: Compiled base · FP16
runtimes.detail: Higher modeled warm throughput, but a longer warm-up and shape-specific validation burden.

runtimes.label: Distilled model · FP16
runtimes.detail: Fewer denoising evaluations; validate quality on each product slice.

runtimes.label: Quantized weights
runtimes.detail: Lower modeled memory with no assumed speedup; numerical and quality validation remain mandatory.

batchPolicies.label: Immediate dispatch
batchPolicies.detail: Batch size one minimizes fill wait but can underuse the accelerator.

batchPolicies.label: Compatible microbatch
batchPolicies.detail: Wait briefly for matching model, shape, precision, and policy contracts.

batchPolicies.label: Throughput-first batch
batchPolicies.detail: A larger batch raises modeled throughput, memory, and fill delay.

safetyPolicies.label: Layered · fail closed
safetyPolicies.detail: Prompt admission, output evaluation, and provenance must all complete before publication.

safetyPolicies.label: Output check only
safetyPolicies.detail: Less latency, but no independent prompt admission boundary.

safetyPolicies.label: Bypass on timeout
safetyPolicies.detail: Keeps availability by publishing when a mandatory safety dependency is unavailable.

retryPolicies.label: No automatic retry
retryPolicies.detail: No amplification, but transient failures remain visible to the caller.

retryPolicies.label: Bounded + idempotent
retryPolicies.detail: One reconciled retry shares the original deadline and commits one terminal result.

retryPolicies.label: Blind three attempts
retryPolicies.detail: Retries unknown completion states without reconciling the first worker.
